Name: ShopAnyTime
Author: S1MPLEW
Description:
Shop Anytime
    Never wait for a shop to open again. Walk into any shop in the valley whenever you want — doors unlock, counters
  are
    ready, no owner required.
    What it does
    - All building doors open 24/7 — Pierre's General Store, the Saloon, the Blacksmith, the Clinic, and every other
  shop
    door works any time of day: early mornings, late nights, Wednesdays. It's like carrying a
    permanent Town Key — one that works where the Town Key doesn't.
    - Shop counters need no owner — buy and sell at any counter even when the NPC isn't around. The mod uses the game's
    own ownerless-shop system, so everything behaves exactly like vanilla shops that already work this way.
    - Every shop, vanilla and modded — includes shops added by other mods, like Stardew Valley Expanded.
    Requirements
    - Stardew Valley 1.6.x
    - SMAPI 4.x
    Install
    1. Install SMAPI.
    2. Drop the ShopAnyTime folder into your Mods folder.
    3. Launch the game — done. No configuration needed.
    Uninstall
    Delete the Mods\ShopAnyTime folder. That's it.
  Compatibility
   Works alongside Content Patcher, Stardew Valley Expanded, and most other mods. If another mod changes the same door
  or shop behavior, whichever loads last wins.Sunberry Village is supported too.
